From the text, note that these are residuals from a least squares regression line and the question asks whether a linear model is appropriate. Apply the residual-plot diagnostic rule: a linear model is appropriate only if residuals show no systematic pattern and are randomly scattered about 0. Since the plot shows curvature, conclude that a line is not an appropriate model.
